notes.title: Work on the game - holiday period
notes.content:
Welcome!

We have plenty of news to share and a few interesting technical aspects of the game.
First of all, we would like to announce the Early Access release date. On November 20, 2025, you’ll be able to purchase Early Access on Steam and play our game for the very first time. To make sure this won’t be a blind shot, we decided to once again release a refreshed demo version — it will be available about two weeks before the launch. We will let you know as soon as the demo is ready. The demo will cover a full in-game day, new tasks, and new mechanics that we want to present to you. In the meantime, we encourage you to check out the new trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eZWP6taaP8k

A few technical aspects

Game language

At the very beginning, you’ll be able to choose from several languages. At a later stage of development, this place will feature a short quiz that will let you test your knowledge, and the game will decide whether you need to complete training before starting the main storyline.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/6bfa73e1cd4dbc69faa8b4963c0b4f8fd989eade.gif

Currently available languages: English, Polish, Spanish, Norwegian, French, German, Danish, Finnish, Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazilian), Italian, Romanian, Turkish, and Hungarian.

We also have translations ready for Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Czech, and Russian. These languages will be available later. As for other languages not yet listed, we plan to add them over time.

Avatar

We’ve also changed a few technical aspects of creating a new world or selecting a previously created one. You can now choose an avatar that will accompany you until the end of the game. In the view of all created worlds, the current title of the player will also be displayed. For example: Junior IT Specialist, Senior IT Specialist, Junior HelpDesk Specialist.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/914ae166d99d705f09af5ab3f8b161938a6f7715.gif

Game save

The save system has also been updated. First of all, tasks with a completion time longer than 9 hours will not disappear — they will simply be carried over to the next day (even if only a minute remains before the SLA ends). We want everything to work exactly as intended. That’s why the save and translation systems are our own custom solutions that we’ve spent a lot of time developing. We don’t want to use ready-made tools commonly found in indie games. We want to give you more. We want to show that IT Specialist Simulator will not only be a game but also a valuable learning tool.

Statistics

Next to the Map and Tasks tabs, you’ll now find a Statistics tab. There you’ll see general gameplay statistics as well as a breakdown by task type, such as networking or office printers. Each statistic has 4 levels — Locked, Beginner, Intermediate, Senior.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/a8ab8b5b8a8fa4b37c13ab8e094dd1eba06f7acb.gif

Achievements

We’ve fixed several bugs. Statistics are now displayed in every language available in the game, and more.

Gameplay

Router

We know many of you expect highly accurate representations of real devices. When it comes to the Router in the game at level 1 – IT Specialist, it’s an SD-WAN Router. We’ve redesigned the graphical interface and added a few new categories to better resemble the original. We still plan a few more changes, such as sending configuration to the router after changing providers, etc.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/4e8f39190f945ef6cf108e17b852b46cb20ea205.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/8d211bd8106d63d2655913fbb812fb4905931df4.gif

Switch

Switches have also undergone slight changes — some categories have been rearranged or removed altogether. Additionally, a new division into main categories has been introduced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/c711be81b09a0721a9920bdca33571ce1a6b8f70.gif

Firewall

Of course, we couldn’t launch without a firewall. Who hasn’t disabled the firewall to download pirated software? Hmm… some employees in our game surely have strange ideas! The firewall comes with a few basic functions. The main one, of course, is enabling and disabling it, which may cause some complications.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/500195e28e83918702bd395de5f74aff813c4b14.gif

Control Panel

The Control Panel has gone through a small makeover. It now offers both small and large icon views. Several new functions have also been unlocked — you’ll definitely want to test them out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/2696bd8a5aa52272ccb53da50722c40c2c400749.gif

RCP Reader – Time Attendance Recorder

The reader gained several new system settings, new animations, and one was fixed. Naturally, the RCP also has its own browser page. Once you gain access, you’ll be able to change a dozen or so interesting parameters. Each one is important — changing, for example, the GROUP ID to a value different from the procedures will prevent employees from being logged into the system. Most RCP-related tasks will have 24 hours to solve. The current number of tasks is 7 (network – 1, configuration – 3, system – 3). At Early Access launch, this number will increase to between 10 and 15. The exact breakdown by category can be found on our Discord.

When visiting the RCP page, you may notice a security warning — this is another new feature added to the browser.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/f18668de4084fbe377c76099d4d4ba853a417d7e.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/e8b1cac87f9958adc8252728d84cfc1d3c3f2f1b.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/fa30211bd57ae819c227160e81db84260ef6f5f8.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/dadc0bf13538ea1ca6f35ef884dcfa981c709379.gif

Browser

As you may have noticed, websites have changed quite a bit. We didn’t forget about the browser itself either. We’ve added browser settings — you can now change your avatar and the main browser color. You may also find some smaller elements, though they’re still being designed. We’ve also added hover animations for the top bar buttons, along with tooltips explaining their functions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/cd4f2f19c1e09a34c1224c3c264580638e467af3.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/b26eabb174acd29223c51d5cecda3b94ad90367c.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/0421d31f5d537cb637a65d161fdc9f2a54f3d7b9.gif

Subpages

We also updated the wiki procedures view, added new articles to the HelpForum, and changed the way they’re displayed. Additionally, when you download a file attached to an email, a special page will open along with a download notification in the top right corner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/d119db1aac36899fd42b189b793af22b554bdc0c.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/361f6ffb9f105d38fc635b1e68dfaff0323d3c64.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/a425182e905bb3ed1bb5da31d3da7516a2f5229b.gif

VirusPlus

In September, we’ll also focus on the antivirus to refine its functionality and usability in the game. We’ve currently added one category responsible for hacker attacks. It will display information about irregularities or system breaches.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/16bbf47aa858e3bb33dcebac588e7bfd777e3702.gif

Tablet

We’ve also completed a preparatory stage of tablet settings. The most important elements are already fully functional. You can now test how WiFi connection works. We wanted it to be more complex than just entering a password. We’ve used our experience with configuring company tablets, so you’ll be able to learn a bit from it. Additionally, we’ve added a PDF app to the tablet, allowing you to send and open PDF files with no issues (more file types coming soon).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/f000e6a1939506d978ab612707f5e1211b01d1aa.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/e2204c07673995d8c5561aa2d943cd1d630a3e82.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/24e7c63c1f42826d4dc415765a27126e4fb45625.gif

Thanks

There isn’t much time left until the Early Access release. But remember, we’re doing everything as planned. We also ask for your feedback on our Discord. Thank you for every game follow, wishlist addition, or following Pixel Team Red on Steam. This is a hobby project into which we’ve put a huge amount of time, working daily on the game over the past year. We’ll continue to develop it after release until it’s ready for full launch. On our Discord, you’ll find not only the current task count but also our development roadmap. Once again, thank you for all the kind words and the warm reception of the demo — even though it wasn’t fully polished!

Thank you.

Social Media:
Discord: https://discord.gg/Rn6C2TQBM4

Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@pixelteamred8072

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/pixelteamred/

Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/company/pixelteamred/

notes.title: Work on the game - June
notes.content:
Welcome!

The Steam Next Festival is behind us. Thank you for playing the game demo. At the same time, we’d like to inform you that the demo content was just a portion of the features that will actually be in the final game.

We’ve been closely watching YouTube videos, Twitch livestreams, and the survey you filled out. Even though the festival has ended, we’re still receiving new responses. Thank you!

Interesting survey data:

 2 respondents used the trash bin (1.6%)
 60.2% of players chose the normal difficulty level
 13.8% of players didn’t use the map at all
 43.1% of players completed only between 0–5 tasks, while 8.9% completed more than 10
 The most common terminal command was help
 71.5% of respondents have experience in the IT industry
 99.2% of respondents believe the game has the potential to be an educational tool


We’re doing our best to respond in real-time. Thanks to you, we’ve caught many bugs! We also added a few features to the demo to improve the gameplay experience. So what exactly was added during the festival?

New features and bug fixes during the festival

Added features

 Mail received several new settings. You can now disable notification sounds and choose which categories to receive notifications from (including Jobbly). In the Mail settings, you can also adjust text size and message style. We added some new emails too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/9ae0e7500cb41b9d94c39c6fcf3a262b1688208d.gif


 Terminal (cmd) – we added a new command bcdedit, which will have multiple uses in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/d972166f122a41bb7de883c0c11599f1a8088ee6.gif

Changes

 Increased demo duration to about 45 minutes
 Reduced volume for some sound effects
 Added the ability to open network adapter properties with a double-click
 Added more information to the map – displaying employees at their computers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/b8420392df8428a7da02461c7976f3cb7bcf2d8e.gif

What’s next?

As you know, development doesn’t stop with the demo. We continue building the game, aiming to create something we’d enjoy playing ourselves. So in June, we took a short break from game development – but that doesn’t mean we did nothing!

ForumHelp

We’ve added a forum with a few articles that should help you in the game. Everything you need to complete tasks can be found in ForumHelp or the PDF files.

Tablet – Mail

We mainly added the Mail app, so players no longer have to run to their computer – something many of you requested. We originally planned to include this at launch, but decided to add it now. You can browse emails on the tablet. However, changing Mail settings is only possible at your PC.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/d4f127dab29d92c2d0c358d1d9f0617b0c57a08d.gif

Tablet – Authentication

We’ve added some details about the last login and the most recent blocked login attempt.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/27c20c63229fb4011c9c0736d89b0a2226a7428d.gif

Tablet – VirusPlus

We added a feature that allows you to copy VirusPlus activation codes to use on other computers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/d86b9cf219e1179ac751087a741e9c09db1ca023.gif

Tablet – Settings

We’re currently adding tablet settings. So far, we’ve implemented:

 wallpaper change
 airplane mode
 battery status
 WiFi settings
 tablet info (part of the "Main" tab)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/04d2ed8c50d942d433d78931df340732c58c3231.gif

We’ll keep working on this to make it the best we can. There’s still a lot to do with the tablet settings. For example, players will need to manually configure WiFi to connect to a network.

Tablet – File System

The most frequently mentioned feature in surveys. Thanks to this system, you’ll be able to transfer files between your PC, cloud, and tablet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/4020cefee1b472637c5cce409eb397f5e1d9adef.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/43c7ca8c9435d764b4ea890784554e1c5f8f3227.gif

Computer – Settings

We’ve added several new wallpapers and a new color palette. You can now transfer .txt, .jpg, .png, and .pdf files to the cloud.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/1b8f7ef293c44568be10c2d5590eea9912dccf13.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/2f1a543d21c04d3646ea1469a5d80539fd7122f4.gif

Computer – No OS

From now on, if the system is not installed, you’ll see a special screen informing you that no OS was detected. Previously, it only showed the Boot Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/635b8bbebde772a72b96511b83436ef214f4b81d.gif

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
We’re slowly going through the survey responses — if you filled it out, we’ve definitely seen your feedback. We’ve fixed a few things in the demo to make it easier to, for example, find the correct computer.

A few people mentioned vision issues, which made reading emails difficult — we took that into account. You were annoyed by Jobbly notifications — we took that into account, too.

From now on, in the email app you can:

- Change the font size → applies to the email body only

- Change the font style → applies to the email body only

- Disable notification sounds

- Disable notifications for categories: general, jobbly, spam (disabled by default)

Fixes:

- Email counters now update properly after sending an email, as long as the app is open

- The email list now updates when a new email arrives

Terminal (cmd):

- We’ve added the bcdedit command with the following arguments:

  - bcdedit /enum

  - bcdedit /enum all

  - help bcdedit

  - bcdedit default

  - bcdedit /timeout

  - bcdedit find — here we made a small change compared to the original; normally it should be bcdedit | find

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/7e31ecb58dc005f85bd526bfb078a4e695878d35.png"]

Added:

- We've extended the general level gameplay time to approximately 45 minutes,

- Added the option to disable email notification sounds — available in the email settings,

- Added a new informational email during gameplay,

- Added a new forum thread type — Networks — currently there's only one thread there,

- Added a new slide to the tutorial on the general level,

- Added a new TV channel to the intro,

- Added sound effects to the intro,

- Added the ability to open network card properties via double-click

- Added new information about employees on map



Fixed:

- Fixed several minor typos,

- Reduced the volume of sound effects,

- Fixed a bug related to the network card where the player couldn't click the "Properties" button,

- Improved the display of the network card window – the blue highlight now disappears when clicking anywhere outside



We're actively reviewing and analyzing every comment on Steam and YouTube. We're also reading through the surveys you're filling out — thank you! ❤️  However, we’d like to clarify a few things:



- We will not be adding mechanics related to eating and sleeping on the general level,

- The Early Access release will include only the general level (and possibly the first specialization branch),

- The general level will have its own tutorial, similar to the one in the intro,

- The general level will gain a second floor — currently under renovation 😅,

- Computers, network devices, and other equipment will gain many new features,



We're planning around 250–350 different tasks for the Early Access release 😅

notes.title: Work on the game - May
notes.content:
Welcome!

In less than a week, you'll be able to play the game demo. For us, that means less and less time to show you the most important things we’ve managed to accomplish. We've prepared a lot for the demo—but more on that at the very end.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3266090/IT_Specialist_Simulator/

New logo

We’d also like to inform you that we’ve finally chosen the new game logo. We hope you’ll like it too.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/9b0b77d918f8ae79026f8cacc0417233b3066cee.png

RACK Cabinets

A few things have changed. Most notably, the design of the buttons—also RJ45 ports have a new look. We think it looks much better now! In addition, as you can see, the number of patch panels has increased. Every connection—regardless of whether the addressing is correct or not—is now shown on the switch, indicating whether a device is connected. From now on, if you make a mistake configuring ports on the router, a physical factory reset will restore the base configuration.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/0d2b91845570d4790cf23f1d0610d9677e7c25f3.gif

RCP

We’ve been working on finalizing RCP. We’ve added numerous settings, including network addressing configuration. We also fixed a few bugs related to RCP and more. The demo doesn’t feature any RCP tasks—we didn’t add enough functionality yet to make it worthwhile. We’ve added brightness adjustment and an eye protection option that gives the screen a yellow tint.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/0b44e9eaa225e4a7a8f1eb601d8a2b0a6b7d503e.gif

Tablet

We’ve added some improvements to the tablet, including changes to the app layout and main view. The tablet now responds to the distance from Access Points—if you’re too far, apps will take longer to load and will have delayed responses.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/c8865d7f70fdb67badb906a27da1903733c5f76f.gif

File downloads

We improved the file download system and added a new file type—.pdf. Most downloadable files will be available in the in-game Wiki.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/ebf6b27d8d2941cc5483279548c388baedbaff67.gif

PDF Reader

We’ve added an app for opening PDF documents. Its main purpose is to preview repair or installation procedures based on standards. You’ll find a few procedures in the demo. Most of them will be available in the Wiki, which is accessible only via VPN.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/4aabafa904ef03e32a1eae9a615f5f81fc4eadaf.gif

Mail

We improved the way messages are displayed in Mail. From now on, each task must be read in the Mail app first. We also added a new feature: attachments. There are two types of attachments—links and PDF files.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/335371651437100f8333459bc17b8568cd4df2d3.gif

Permissions

We added file access permissions—if a user doesn’t have access, they simply won’t be able to open the file. In Early Access, this will be expanded—changing user permissions will require administrator login or terminal use.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/1f0811a22a67d8d40e07d1cba62d4f415395c84e.gif

New errors

We’ve added several new errors related to permissions and applications. For example, if an app is missing files, it won’t launch and a message will appear. We also added a message for no network connection on the login screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/64a7fda5e5235b23ad64a3e57b549a3cc9dfe9ce.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/0638411be3ef1103268855bb707f0551c0f79e26.gif

Administrator account

We’re actively working on implementing the administrator account, which will allow us to restrict functions for regular users—for example, disabling access to the Control Panel. Unfortunately, the administrator account won’t be ready for the demo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/4b5d71c4156fa22f54a68421f8a30de94492de52.gif

P-Mail

We’ve added a new email app—this one is for employees only and will be available for download in the app store.

VirusPlus

We’ve finished implementing PC scanning and virus detection. You can also activate the Pro version by entering a license key purchased from the developer’s website. All activation codes can be viewed in the tablet app.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/6825dcabec065d13951f3507f669a68a50c28b3b.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/8ea04da4d406b32a31c916ae02d1c8bfe31f52c9.gif

AppStore

We improved app downloads and added a few new apps—some of which will be available in the demo. We also fixed important bugs related to browsing and downloading. You can now also create app shortcuts on the desktop.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/9814f2b17f04a2179dd365443a5cb1a890dcbd08.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/e42789d7796bbffa63c0b433deda688320b272b9.gif

Missing app?

From now on, if an app is missing from the system, its related files will show a generic icon. You can then either open the file in Notepad or search for the app in the store.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/f71f0bc8e30223234fd38f26bce13120c03d1602.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/a7ac44667639a84356e88989a68298a78590abb3.gif

New tasks and fixes

We’ve added several new tasks to expand the demo gameplay. Most of them are related to networking. Older tasks were also revised. Every task is adjusted to the difficulty level selected by the player at the beginning. On easy and hard modes, task hints are available.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/ad9995c42e11a860d55863184c240cba6148c070.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/8a30521a14ff3756b6d30845c394ea43b8ede8ee.gif

Map

The map has also been slightly updated. We’ve added the ability to check tasks from each device and introduced “ghost mode,” allowing free map navigation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/cfd2b222a629f9d0915a4b92db574c9294cd8728.gif

System installation

We fixed some bugs. From now on, after installation, the system will automatically log in and display familiar messages during the first boot.

Greyed-out buttons

We’ve unlocked a few buttons visible in settings, Control Panel, etc. We want to show that these features aren’t finished yet, but highlight what’s coming in Early Access.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/c8a9b57097618588829af9ab9e9ac4e375375f9b.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/57c6abd2e5fd3119073473596a4663d33cd8d5a7.gif

Game optimization

Throughout the development process, we’ve faced lighting challenges. Ultimately, we decided to use baked lighting across maps, which significantly improved both quality and performance. Thanks to our publisher FreeMind and the team behind Aquarist, we achieved highly satisfying visual results.
We also implemented realistic reflections in every window, further increasing immersion. Most importantly, we optimized the game to the point where frame rates increased from 50 to 230 FPS on ultra settings. We can confidently say: there should be no performance issues in the demo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/3060e889246fa82882d59752177270e3a51cd496.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/8e304d9e31a06219223df104d9da5ca5010da4cf.png

notes.title: Work on the game - April
notes.content:
Hey! What's up with you?

The demo is getting closer, so we want to show you what we've been working on for the past month. It was quite a difficult month for us in many ways. However, we still have mid-April and May ahead of us. Well, exactly...

Game Demo

In the demo of our game, we want to show you what the game will look like with EarlyAccess. How functions, programs, etc. will work more or less. Many things will not be in the game yet or we will simply block them due to not completing them in their entirety. What is important to us in this demo? First of all, feedback, but not in the form of "the game is ok", but specifically what needs to be changed and why or what is cool. Remember, we are also gamers and we also like to play good games, so we want to make one like that too. That is, a game that you can sit down and play calmly, learn something. There is a high probability that we will not complete the ForumHelp for the demo, so we will leave all the solutions to the tasks in the Guides section.

Okay, but what has changed in the game?

Intro - Tutorial

Exactly, let's start with the tutorial because why not. From now on, when creating a new world, we will get a short tutorial and a short story. The story of finding a job....

In the tutorial, we will learn a few key mechanics for the game. The standard is walking, looking around and crouching. However, we will also show you a few other interesting options and if you have never changed the network address on your computer, this will be your first time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/3d858c23e28d5fa1aa53ca8e658d6771830d8153.gif

A computer with three monitors

We managed to create the first computer that works almost perfectly with three monitors. We can flip application windows between monitors without any major problems. Now we will also work on two screens that are different sizes. Specifically, we want the effect of a laptop and an additional monitor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/1ad74acae0f16d8b54ab87f30c2f17bf92755d11.gif

Websites

We have introduced several new pages. Each one serves a different purpose.

PixelTeamRed

Of course, this page was already in the game under the link https://pixelteamred.com/ but we have added 3 more subpages.

 Software - the page that will interest you the most because of the files that can be downloaded from it. It will mainly be an iso file with the OScypek system for system installation.
 About - here you can find a very short history about us
 Games - and here we have added a preliminary view of our old games. This view will probably be changed.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/6daeaa7c2f900840785922ab0d2fd1014a43d5b2.gif

Wiki - Storage - knowledge base

Many companies have their own wikis, where you can find procedures, some appropriate answers to questions, links to other external sites, etc. We also wanted to add something similar to this. So we present you Wiki - Storage. The portal is accessible by using Fasko OneConnect (VPN), otherwise Error 404 will pop up. On the portal you will be able to find information about the addressing standard in the company, other branches of the company (in what city they are and not only), there is also information about us - i.e. about the creators, but more detailed, who and for what was responsible during the creation of the game. And the main tab will be procedures. Procedures will refer, for example, to the configuration of the router, due to the specificity of this particular model that we have chosen - there is no information about the configuration of such equipment in the network.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/8b8835a33286dc6261aaa1355e14e8309b51242c.gif

VirusPlus

VirusPlus antivirus website, which will help us get rid of malware and more. On the website, you will be able to basically only buy a new license. In several different variants, we are considering entering all data such as company name, NIP, etc. - but only for players who choose the difficulty level - hard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/b211767de1626099d802263e7a5d20e309e7dcb2.gif

VirusPlus - application 

As I mentioned the antivirus page, it is worth mentioning the antivirus itself. The antivirus will have several significant tasks to perform. Including story tasks, which we do not want to write about at the moment. Currently, we can only enter the activation code for the PRO version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/93537909c2d3649611713f398c56bdf0464a44e0.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/c13cc09d33ecac7b606ddacf1acee4ffc6b131c8.gif

Application Store

As the name suggests, we will be able to download applications, some applications will be important like the previously mentioned VirusPlus and less important like mini-games. In each application/game, you will find information about it, reviews, application size, publisher and release date of this application or game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/2d618d16c51bd3c5410230b24dd2017dbfbdc0e0.gif

Mail

We've refreshed Mail a bit. We've added settings and the ability to change the background. Some of them really blend in well. We've fixed a bug with the time not being displayed next to emails and we've added some cool story emails.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/e5c71c95ef5ec6a593f782a0602e4a98bd409f29.gif

Shadows

On many devices, we have added shadows to graphics to improve the display of elements.

New loading screen

We have slightly changed the loading screen, from now on it will always show a curiosity or information useful in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/f29396b945ed280158a02bdd02dd3b87962dd45a.gif

A few notes

Remember that we are not the creators of this game 24/7. Each of us has a different job and the game is created solely as a hobby. We try to make the game really high-quality and a really good example in schools or universities.

notes.title: Work on the game - March
notes.content:
Some new information

Hello!

The time has come when we have to announce it! ːsteamhappyː The game will be available under a new name: IT Specialist Simulator. With the new name, we hope that we will reach more interested players and the new name will better indicate what you can find in the game! But that's not all! We would also like to inform you that the publisher of the game will be FreeMind S.A., which is responsible for publishing e.g. House Builder, Farmer's Life or a similar game ServiceIT: You can do IT

And when it comes to news, we also have a few for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3266090/IT_Specialist_Simulator/

Tasks

For over two weeks, you can complete the first tasks. We have only added ten of them for testing. Each task will have an assigned SLA, i.e. a time in which it must be completed. Completing a task after the SLA time will affect the reward, and not completing a task before the end of the day if its SLA indicates the day in which the player is currently located will double the penalty. You can find the current list of tasks on the guides page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/8f4b99f5a2bdb6be1b97db3c6bae33a103fbb5a5.gif

Adjusting the game level

We have used several mechanics, so that if you choose, for example, the easy level, you will see all applications and you will not have to use commands in the Run application. However, if you choose, for example, the difficult level, you will have surprises in some tasks.

Map

We have added a map to the game, which can make the game easier for you to some extent. On the map, you will find specific information about which device is damaged and what task awaits you there. We decided to make the map rotational, i.e. it rotates according to the player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/5926c98bc98c9d9b3ed31464159cf09ba975bb98.gif

EventLog

We have added the possibility and even necessity of using a tool such as EventLog. Thanks to this tool, the player will be guided to errors. In this place, you will also be able to find other information and system warnings. In the application, the player can see the information in XML view, we are also working on adding additional information here on the Properties button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/b90596025c5149b059a9958ea39e8caed64508e9.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/b73e2ca06884f1b833e888ea842bc4abbe5e28c6.gif

Office Printers

You may have noticed printers much earlier in other GIFs, films or photos. However, they had no functionality. Currently, printers are interactive and can be connected to the network, have their software updated or the drum level checked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/d9cec3052a9020a3b640f2ba08e48154d7b08e97.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/fb1c6779d9793e01c4466e08f0a72a1cf160f03a.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/1059811a4cdeb40eae5f3c576459d9318ce70125.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/942979333cae6eb02c651991ea6e740cf4920076.gif

Tablet

We have added one application on the tablet, which will be just a curiosity about us. We plan to add a few applications to the demo, but everything in due time. We also plan to configure tablets, e.g. of other employees, thanks to sfw#setup, but we haven't gotten to that point yet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/d53715eab8e786a9d26fd32f253afe024703b048.gif

Errors

We have fixed a lot of logical errors in the source code. There are currently no cosmic anomalies :P

What's next?

[olist]
 We are currently creating an Antivirus, which will be called VirusPlus,
 An application store, so that the player has access to install them on new computers,
 We want to improve the task system and of course add new, more complicated tasks,
 We are also creating a special introductory room, where the player will have their first encounter with the game,
 Creating new websites,
 Completing the entire RCP system,
[/olist]

For the demo, we will want to polish many elements of the gameplay so that the game is pleasant to play. See you! Don't turn off your routers!

notes.title: Game Update - February
notes.content:
Hello! 

It's been a while since the last update, so we want to show you what we've managed to do over the next month. We've made a few minor changes to the player interface, but thanks to that the interface is more user-friendly. We've also been creating a system for saving the game for a long time. It was quite a difficult task due to the various mechanics in the game.

Tablet

The first thing that might catch your eye is the tablet. We've added it and are introducing the first applications there. The tablet itself will play a significant role in the game and will be a great convenience for the player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/b1d0ac31a364ec3e87244db7ec5429df84eaac3f.gif

Fasko - OneConnect (VPN)

Until now, to connect to VPN, all you had to do was have Internet access and click the Connect button. Thanks to the tablet, we could add a special application for 2-step verification. Thanks to this, we made this process more realistic. To start VPN, we have to enter the numbers that are displayed on the monitor into the application on the tablet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/14a2a3f9b81250d44e5a6b17330caaadce8e7d00.gif

Settings

We've added a few new settings, a few aesthetic ones, like the screen saver, a few of which change how the computer works. We've also changed the wallpapers available on the computer and fixed a few bugs related to them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/059f41f318648c4594d50fa0bf12cab0a0dcd0f0.gif

Changes in the terminal

We have supplemented the ipconfig command and added the ability to ping other devices with the -t or -T parameter

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/56397bd4c76444e830ab28db1b3a9e683f1aab52.gif

File and folder properties

From now on, you can check the properties of a given file or folder. They have several important parameters, such as file size, which is calculated based on the content. The more we write in the file, the longer it will take to download from the network, send on the network, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/f7d3fad8f569a49a1848c206bc2728d379271e87.gif

Flash drives and disks

We have made every effort to ensure that everything works properly. From now on, each time you connect a new device to the computer, it will be given an appropriate icon and alphabetical letter. From now on, we can boot the flash drive for system installation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/3d6f7d7b9d8bd22a096b452a17329a298b957af4.gif

Hamster Application

The application will be used to boot pendrives and disks. In the application we can choose which pendrive we want to boot, choose the appropriate iso file with the system and a few smaller functions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/fb5a3a12cd6a456f1bccd80e5ca7da4aed93ee65.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/95291a3c8fb8e3ebfc2aace863b632d0a1f23fa0.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/a196ea4bf4d9a62a8da3a79f4d7c7c91c576f693.gif

Web - Jobbly 

We have also completed the ability to apply for every job you can find on the site Jobbly in the game. There are also more offers related to IT and the further course of the game. Each job offer returns two emails. The first email is automatic and informs about the acceptance of the CV by the company. The second email is an email regarding the status.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/bb2c76797ea132ae598b0a4a645fc3cfd20e2325.gif

Router

We have added several options in the Router configuration. As we mentioned before. At a general level, the configuration of both the router and the switch will be graphical. If the player wants to follow the appropriate career path, they will configure these devices via the console. Currently, we have added the option of assigning network addressing to a specific port. Thanks to this procedure, if the player wants to change the switch addressing, they must do it via the router. Additionally, you can enable and disable a specific port on the router, thanks to which we will block a certain part of the network.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/83b18f9807473a727631f58f9ad7838fa3c675a2.gif

Switch

You can access each switch by entering the IP address in the browser. We can change several parameters, check the list of currently connected devices via DHCP, edit which IP address to which DHCP should extend. Additionally, we can check what is connected to each port on the switch. If we change the DHCP range, devices with DHCP enabled will automatically receive a new address if their current address is outside the pool.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/4a6d73d8fe5d7bde4e647be71be48fe1f0239efa.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/33d06447521f67523a9892e76333091f912bd587.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/0297a72c640e84a98e77daf303fcece2bd9a6b68.gif

BIOS

We've fixed a few logic errors related to the BIOS. We have also added a few blue screens related to e.g. damaged VRAM. We have added an option to restore settings to factory settings and an option to exit BIOS without saving. and changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/e7d8ba14920eb3a2b604c8e816698c3f420bc6ed.gif

RCP - work registration reader

We have added a few smaller functionalities, such as: settings, restarting the device, turning off the device if it is only in the RACK cabinet. For now, we do not want to reveal full information about this device.

Cats

Yes, exactly. We have added cats to the game. One of the users of a certain platform wrote that the game must have cats! So, we listened to one of you and added a few cats. For this purpose, we also created a place for them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/089c5ba487ee6ff0a10c0f5ae25d9e7f05fce603.gif

We've added a few new features, but we don't want to reveal them at this time! See you soon!

P.S. Will someone fix our network? :P

notes.title: New PoE devices, addressing settings
notes.content:
Welcome!

We hope everything is going well for you and that you haven't caught any viruses!
We are preparing to introduce the virus mechanics for computers, so soon you’ll have a chance to catch one ːsteamfacepalmː. We’ve already prepared several new websites under this mechanic to mislead players. These websites will primarily come from emails.

Control Panel
The control panel has already been added to the game, and one of its categories is fully operational. Specifically, we’re talking about the Network and Sharing Center. From now on, you can change IPv4 addressing on the computer, view active network cards, and check network data (if the computer is connected to a network).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/a25d0d74df3cf639e5fabf2e3e31f86057b62180.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/c712b1fca91ad3270d3408e4d255b5d71449a1cb.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/1177406cc7ebff07e3679ebfb538de4579168baa.gif

We’ve also added the ability to track network data sent and received in KB, which is displayed in GB in the settings. This is only for troubleshooting network issues, as the data resets every time the connection is lost—just like in real life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/962d856229c345eb98b0ea9942d281a88592dc57.gif

USB Ports on the Computer

We’ve introduced the ability to insert appropriate devices into USB ports, including pendrives and disks. After inserting a disk or pendrive, corresponding folders will appear in the file explorer. Disk and pendrive names will eventually match specific device types, such as "Pendrive OScypek (E:/)." With this option, system installation will function correctly and will only be possible via pendrive. As for network-based system installation, we plan to add this feature later, for higher levels when players want to specialize.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/2a2bb716601310b4a1059efa21e79eccf837e0fc.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/8b743b4dbdea66fb0076a5f749bb888b60e34e86.gif

Changes to the RACK Cabinet

We’ve added the option to reset settings to factory defaults. Thanks to this, if players mess up something, they can completely break the network ːsteamhappyː. On a serious note, this option allows players to rebuild the network entirely from scratch. Of course, they’ll need to reconfigure the computer’s addressing, among other things, to make it all work again.

New Devices

Access Points have been added to the game and can now be seen in three locations. They’ll be configured via a website (connecting through an IP address). APs can only be turned off by disconnecting the patch cord from the switch (PoE port). Connecting the device to a regular port will prevent the AP from starting. Another new device is the RCP, or work registration reader. This device has a screen where players can modify a few options, including the addressing. The RCP also operates on PoE ports. Its configuration is partly handled via a website and partly through on-device settings that can’t be changed remotely. Additionally, repair procedures for both devices will be included in the game, accessible on the computer. We also plan to add cameras and their configuration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/7ff8961766c1dc8f62d1b4793d44de016e3ea8f7.gif

Picking Up Items

We’ve implemented the ability to pick up items into the inventory. Currently, you can pick up patch cords, pendrives, and disks. In addition, several other items will become collectible. Besides this, we plan to introduce a mechanic for carrying items without adding them to the inventory. These will mostly be cosmetic items like food, sheets of paper, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/2a299d549f29c2c67cb8cb1fdc172f1bebd8b958.gif

Inventory Changes

We’ve made several improvements to the inventory and its functionality. First and foremost, every trash can in the game is now functional, and players can throw away unnecessary items. Items in the trash will disappear the next day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/8f0252b9cf3baf66e5aa1e5404765326d80622ec.gif

notes.title: Equipment and installation of systems
notes.content:
Hello!

We hope you're still eagerly waiting for updates about the game! Today, we’re here with a small dose of information. This is, of course, due to the upcoming holidays, which left us with less time for the game. Nevertheless, we’re doing our best to push the game forward every single day.

BIOS – New Options
Let’s start with the BIOS. In the last update, we showed you a few options. Today, there are many more. Each option affects the functionality of the computer. For example, let’s take options like "Platform/Storage/Endorsement Hierarchy." If one of them is set incorrectly, you’ll get a blue screen with an error code.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/c448421a7d1fa2b75b197b2bf7e5bc2a62aadd08.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/bd161439635a60a8a4b362ed12c541dc45298f62.gif

Boot Menu
We’ve also added a boot menu, allowing players to install or repair the system using a pendrive with the OScypek system. Various additional boot options may also appear, but we’ll keep those a secret for now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/560b5f1291766ec60d5d1064a8d1c6505f407810.gif

System Installation
System installation will be quite straightforward, with most data like country and time being static, so players can focus on other tasks. The installation itself won’t take long but will last about 2–3 minutes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/97e32ce24370317ba394dd5ff7926cabc4a06091.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/bdef699aacf9e3ac7e1e2e9a521c7123369ee310.gif

Inventory
Players can now open their portable backpack as well as their locker in the workroom. They can store a variety of items there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/638dd03a37a0459b3eae73eaf705d5489b40306c.gif

Changes to the RACK Cabinet
Thanks to the new inventory system, we’ve added several changes to the RACK cabinets. Now, every disconnection adds a patch cord to your backpack. If you want to make a connection, you’ll need to have a patch cord in your portable backpack. Patch cords are located in the RACK room, so finding them shouldn’t be an issue. However, keep in mind that there are several floors and the option to connect subscriber sockets to computers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/2007f71930d3843a3ea2dacfbe4f5773e4b6ea90.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/7b49ca27e551a61d485bb46d413b3f57cf45f123.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/c75f6588670543333723c52770a63a42d9cbe2cb.gif

A Few New Animations
We’ve also added a few new animations for computers, as well as notifications and more! Now, you can also increase and decrease the size of desktop icons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/27434eb63a4fe16b5ba52d1f6355c51dfdf24350.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/b673a6e92970e8aaed63266a2c95054d65e269fc.gif

notes.title: Some news!
notes.content:
Hey, we're here with some news!
Over the past month, we have been working hard to meet our November goals. Unfortunately, we couldn’t get everything done on time… It’s worth mentioning that we’re making this game after work hours, and it's purely a hobby project.

We would also like to thank everyone who added the game to their wishlist! That's nearly 200 people. Thank you for the support! We hope not to disappoint you. Follow us on other platforms, as soon there will be a chance to test the game ːsteamhappyː

Network Infrastructure
Let's start with the network. The network is practically complete now. The only thing left is adding new types of devices—which won’t be a big problem. From now on, the network is working and has an external connection. If we don’t have a world connection, we’ll only be able to communicate within the company. There's also an option to disconnect switches, the router, and connect the patch panel with the switch. We couldn’t forget about user outlets and computers, either—you can disconnect them, too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/610d125e334b7c409ceb549c77fe952323e589de.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/641d339d49a907cf9ff9692c8174d38d74e0de22.gif

New Websites
We’ve introduced several new websites. Some are just extras with no impact on gameplay, but there are also some more important ones. We’ve started creating a switch management page—to access a switch’s page, you’ll need to enter its IP address. We also have a site called jobbly—a job listings page. It primarily includes IT job listings, providing an option to switch jobs to, for example, helpdesk.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/cbd62e066252b60a52bbd03259a9f314675262fa.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/35ef8dd99d4efc996cf0ccb3a0062a6b87f2327f.gif

Emails
We’ve also added several new types of emails, mainly informational ones regarding the new jobbly site. We fixed a bug that caused the delete button to appear in already deleted emails. From now on, email won’t work without a network connection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/2ae388b5395d04c282c1603fcc478b95a67ae729.gif

Fasko OneConnect
We’ve added a new app, Fasko OneConnect. It’s a VPN, meant for connecting to specific company resources. It will also feature in several in-game tasks, including "installation requests."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/897d7213d831e804fd85ae63a1268ba5397fa0b8.gif

Desktop and Application Appearance
We’ve made a few updates to the desktop, primarily to improve functionality, but there are some visual enhancements, too. Now, whatever is behind an app window will have a blur effect. Additionally, we improved the bottom bar—it now shows open and minimized apps in a better way. We also added basic information on the desktops, such as computer name, addressing, and connection info. Another network-related feature is that right-clicking the bottom-right corner will open some network details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/28598eb63b4281476d4a35be705a228401d3c0dd.gif

BIOS
We’ve added BIOS access under the F12 key during system startup, with several settings that can break the computer. Interestingly, we’re aiming to add around 120 settings to be configured. BIOS will be fully completed in the coming days, and work on the failure system will begin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/ed13be38c81305e8055b7e50a9a36f9546b17c69.gif

New Objects
We’re constantly adding new objects to the game. We place them on the scene and modify the main office layout. We’re trying to make everything look as professional as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/81b3d6824a984b5bc0e0bb9678b6c1b2a475778e.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/8ce31153db4413b1cc714b71b5de3886d7cafc2c.gif

notes.title: New Rooms, New Features, and Solutions
notes.content:
Hello!

Every day, we strive to add new content to the project, including new objects, new solutions, and new features. The main goal is, of course, to have fun and learn. However, we are well aware that a good-looking interface and eye-pleasing background graphics make a big difference. We aim to ensure that every detail, fun fact, task, or game mechanic is well-polished and doesn't disappoint the players.

We also try to communicate with future players and school students to add more tailored tasks to different levels of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/e80916540d25e3406fcef4e56693050427bee51c.png

ːsteamhappyː New features/solutions added: 
 
 We introduced fully functional game settings and the ability to create a new game 
 Added the option to change the language to English - the primary game language, Polish - full support, Spanish, Norwegian, and French 
 Added new commands to the terminal (cmd) 
 Added a crouching option to access subscriber sockets
 Added a MAIL app. In this app, you can read information about new failures/tasks, their status, and completion time. We also added categorization, allowing you to filter only the emails that interest you. 
 Added a browser and several main websites 
 Added the ability to connect network devices in RACK cabinets 
 Added new objects related to the warehouse, such as pallets, boxes, shrink-wrapped goods, and warehouse scaffolding 
 Added security cameras and anti-theft gates 
 Added several smaller decorative elements 
 Added a focus option 
 Added a few animations related to player movement and interactions with the RACK cabinet 


ːsteamthumbsupː Changes made: 
 
 Increased the number of windows in the building - to show more life outside, 
 Improved street traffic [] Added additional doors to the IT Room [Room 103], leading to a small server room 
 Increased the number of buildings 
 Modified several post-processing steps to improve graphics 
 Added the option to minimize apps, with animations for minimizing and maximizing 
 The taskbar is now scalable, so running apps appear there, 
 Changed the way desktop icons are displayed on computers 


We've also made a few smaller tweaks.

We will continue to update you on the game's progress and provide information about the game mechanics.
